reasoning_traces.think:
The façade integrates provider data into a reasoning pipeline through structured delegation. Each input is translated into a DataContext object, which serves as the canonical input for the AnalysisEngine. The engine applies causal chain logic and checklist validation to produce a ReasoningTrace. This process ensures that all outputs are derived from a single, consistent model while preserving modularity through clear separation of concerns. Dualities emerge in how provider signals map to reasoning depth and how adversarial checks prevent false positives. Failure modes include provider misalignment, enum inconsistency, and trace corruption during serialization.
